name: Zygarde
mechanics: Not caught wild -- assembled at a Reassembly Unit block using a Zygarde Cube loaded with Zygarde Cells/Cores (found in Mega Showdown structures): 9 cells+1 core = 10% Forme (Aura Break, ~2 min), 49 cells+1 core = 50% Forme (Aura Break, ~5 min), 95 cells+5 cores = 50% Forme with Power Construct (~10 min). Right-click the Reassembly Unit with a Pokeball when it's done to receive it. Small shiny chance (1/4096) on assembly.
A 50% Forme Zygarde with the Power Construct ability can reach 100% (Complete) Forme in battle when it drops below half HP.

mechanics: Fuses with Solgaleo (N-Solarizer) or Lunala (N-Lunarizer): right-click the donor Pokemon with the item first to charge it, then right-click Necrozma with the charged item to become Dusk Mane or Dawn Wings Necrozma. Fusion inherits Necrozma's IVs/EVs/shiny/level.

name: Ogerpon
mechanics: Changes mask/type by right-clicking with Cornerstone Mask, Hearthflame Mask, or Wellspring Mask (each craftable on this server). Stellar/Tera Shards cannot be used on Ogerpon -- it's hard-coded to skip them, same as Terapagos.

name: Terapagos
mechanics: Not a normal wild spawn. Obtained via Liko's Pendant (crafted from a Dormant Crystal + String) -- wear it or keep it in your inventory and a wild Terapagos spawns after a set time (20 hours by default, server-configurable) for you to catch.

Important: a Terapagos given with /pokegive does NOT get its proper Stellar Tera type -- it gets a random one instead. Only /pokespawn + catching it, or the Liko's Pendant method, gives it the correct guaranteed Stellar Tera type.

Normal Form is its default look outside of battle. It automatically becomes Terastal Form the moment it's sent into any battle. Terastallizing it (while it's Terastal Form) turns it into Stellar Form for that battle, with a big stat boost.

Stellar Tera Shards cannot be used on Terapagos (or Ogerpon) -- both are hard-coded exceptions in the mod's item code. If yours has the wrong Tera type, an admin fixing it with /pokemonedit <slot> teratype=stellar is the only way to correct it after the fact.
